keyword: how many oscars has sean penn won
claims: Sean Penn has won three Academy Awards as of March 2026.

Sean Penn won Best Actor for Mystic River (2004).
Sean Penn won Best Actor for Milk (2009).
Sean Penn has received a total of six Academy Award nominations.

Sean Penn received an Academy Award nomination for Sweet and Lowdown.
